0022600005.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Warriors on the road against the Lakers, and Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (undisclosed), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The Lakers are listed as day-to-day with Adou Thiero, Cameron Carr, Collin Sexton, and Jarred Vanderbilt, all of whom are game-time decisions, and in their most recent meeting, the Warriors lost 119-103 in San Francisco, part of a 2025-26 season series that Golden State lost 1-3. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Warriors a 35% chance of winning.
